epics.title: Accountable engineering loop
epics.objective: Enforce decision 0032 end to end: JIT frontier contracts gated at stage start, evidence-backed grills, bounded reviewable diffs.

tasks.title: Evidence records under the story directory
tasks.objective: A single story_dir() path helper routes every recorder and gate to .factory/stories/<KEY>/ for new stories, with read fallback to the legacy live singletons and history/ so existing data stays readable.
acceptance_criteria: the in-scope recorders (decomposition, grill, test, review) and verify write and read new-story artifacts under .factory/stories/<KEY>/ through one shared path helper
legacy live and history layouts remain readable by those same consumers

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Single-source resolution is the whole game: story_dir(root, key) plus one evidence_path(root, key, name) accessor in factory_lib must be the ONLY place layout knowledge lives; a recorder or gate joining paths by hand forks the layout. Write-new/read-both: writers go story-scoped for stories intaken under the new layout, readers fall back legacy-first-miss. SCOPE BOUNDARY: this task covers the recorders in write_scope (decomposition, grill, test, review) and verify ONLY; plans.py and pr_ready.py read the plan grill / archive by hand but are the migration-and-vendor task's job - the required test must NOT exercise those paths (three prior signals hit exactly that). A budget overrun is the split signal, not a reason-raise.

plan_contracts.statement: the in-scope recorders (decomposition, grill, test, review) and verify write and read new-story artifacts under .factory/stories/<KEY>/ through one shared path helper
legacy live and history layouts remain readable by those same consumers

tasks.title: The active-story pointer leaves version control
tasks.objective: Move the active-story pointer out of version control: run_state_path() resolves to a worktree-local untracked pointer under the git control dir, with tracked .factory/run.json still readable for legacy repos. New-layout stories write only the untracked pointer; phase derives from story-dir artifact presence. Single-source in factory_lib so the ~20 read consumers follow unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: two worktrees intake different stories with zero tracked run.json writes
phase derivation matches the old run.json semantics for legacy repos

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Single-source run_state_path is the whole game (same discipline as story_dir in task 1): the ~20 read consumers follow the helper and must NOT be edited individually. The untracked pointer MUST resolve via the git control dir (git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir), never a literal root/.git join - in a linked worktree .git is a FILE, so a naive join writes the pointer to the wrong place and merges can still see it. Read resolves untracked-first then legacy .factory/run.json; write goes untracked only for new-layout (marker present), legacy stays tracked. Phase derives from story-dir artifact presence, matching the old stored-phase semantics for legacy. SCOPE BOUNDARY: does not touch read consumers, pr_ready archival (ship-in-place), event files (per-event-files), or intake-marker migration for existing repos (migration-and-vendor); required tests must not exercise those.

plan_contracts.statement: two worktrees intake different stories with zero tracked run.json writes
phase derivation matches the old run.json semantics for legacy repos

tasks.title: Events are one file each
tasks.objective: append_event writes each event as its own conflict-free file (retiring the events.jsonl union-merge driver) instead of appending to the shared ledger; load_events / forge history / the board read per-event files and the legacy events.jsonl together. Single-source in events.py so the ~20 callers and the board follow unchanged. Marker-neutral per decision 0046.
acceptance_criteria: recording an event creates a new file and appends to no shared ledger
forge history renders legacy and per-file events in one timeline

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: Single-source append_event/load_events is the whole game: the ~20 callers and board.py read through load_events and must NOT be edited individually. Per-event files are conflict-free by unique name; append_event must STOP appending to the shared events.jsonl (that retires the union driver) and the merge=union entry for events.jsonl must be removed from .gitattributes. load_events reads per-event files AND legacy events.jsonl, preserving the story/event/since/until filters and the per-line JSONDecodeError tolerance (a torn legacy line costs one event, never the timeline). append_event stays best-effort on write (OSError swallowed) but validate_payload is NOT swallowed. Marker-neutral per 0046: events touch no deferred consumer (plans.py/pr_ready), so retirement is unconditional and does not activate the story-scoped layout. SCOPE: does not touch the callers, board.py, plans.py, or pr_ready.

plan_contracts.statement: recording an event creates a new file and appends to no shared ledger
forge history renders legacy and per-file events in one timeline

tasks.title: pr_ready ships without moving files
tasks.objective: For a new-layout story (marker present), pr_ready marks it shipped INSIDE its story directory - no archive move, no rename strands - and outcome.json routes story-scoped; a legacy story (marker off) keeps the existing archive-to-history flow unchanged. Board and forge history read shipped story dirs. Roadmap done-flip unchanged. Marker-neutral per decision 0046.
acceptance_criteria: pr_ready completes with zero file moves and evidence stays at its recorded paths
board and forge history read shipped stories from the story directory

required_tests.command: uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}
uvx --with pytest --with psutil python3 -m pytest {path}::{id} -q -o junit_family=legacy --junitxml={report}

tasks.reviewer_focus: The ship path MUST branch on the scoped-layout marker: new-layout (marker present) ships IN PLACE - the story dir already holds all evidence (tasks 1-3), so pr_ready records shipped state in the story dir (a shipped marker or derive_phase's shipped rung) and performs ZERO shutil.move; a legacy story (marker off) keeps the exact archive-to-history + plans/completed move it does today (0046: no production story runs new-layout yet, so the legacy path must stay bit-for-bit unchanged - the third required test guards it). outcome.json routes through evidence_path (D-0028). pr_ready STOPS its own grill archival (S-0002) but does NOT touch plans.py (S-0001 defer to migration-and-vendor). Idempotent rerun for new-layout keys on the in-place shipped marker, not the history archive. board.py is IN scope for the READ path only: it hard-codes story-evidence roots as .factory (active) or .factory/history/<key> (shipped) and must resolve .factory/stories/<KEY>-first with .factory and .factory/history fallback (task 1's story-first/legacy-fallback discipline). This is read-only - board never breaks on activation and reads legacy in production while the marker is off (0046). forge history already reads via load_events/evidence_path. SCOPE: pr_ready + outcome recorder + tests only.

plan_contracts.statement: pr_ready completes with zero file moves and evidence stays at its recorded paths
board and forge history read shipped stories from the story directory

tasks.title: Hooks survive merges and permit scoped resolution
tasks.objective: With unmerged index entries, pre_tool_use permits git-native resolution (checkout --ours/--theirs, rm, add) for exactly those paths while refusing content hand-writes; unparseable factory_lib or state engages a static deny-list fallback instead of crashing; forge next auto-heals the roadmap after a merge commit.
acceptance_criteria: the carve-out matrix passes: resolution allowed for exactly the unmerged set, refused outside it, deny-list fallback engages on broken imports
forge next heals the roadmap after a merge without being asked

tasks.title: Legacy repos cut over at intake; clients get it via upgrade
tasks.objective: The next intake on a legacy repo starts the story-scoped layout without touching old artifacts; forge upgrade carries the change to client repos; docs sweep; the merge-simulation gate test proves two concurrent stories produce zero overlapping .factory paths.
acceptance_criteria: intake on a legacy fixture starts the new layout with old artifacts untouched and readable
the merge-simulation test merges two concurrent story branches with zero .factory conflicts
